articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Enhanced Reasoning and 500K Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, its most capable model to date, featuring a 500,000 token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on graduate-level math and coding benchmarks, surpassing previous records. Claude 4 is now available via API and through Claude.ai for Pro and Team subscribers.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves Human-Level Performance on New Medical Diagnosis Benchmark
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini 2.5 Ultra has reached human-level accuracy on MedBench 2026, a comprehensive medical diagnosis dataset developed in collaboration with Johns Hopkins University. The model correctly diagnosed rare conditions in 91.3% of test cases, compared to specialist physicians averaging 89.7%. Google emphasized the model is intended to assist rather than replace medical professionals.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous AI Agents for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator platform with Operator Pro, a suite of autonomous AI agents designed to handle complex, multi-day enterprise workflows including procurement, HR onboarding, and financial reconciliation. The new tier includes enhanced tool-use capabilities and integrates directly with SAP, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics. Early enterprise customers report a 40% reduction in administrative overhead in pilot programs.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine Against Facial Recognition Startup
articles.summary: The newly established EU AI Office has issued a €47 million fine against Paris-based startup ClearVision AI for deploying a high-risk facial recognition system without completing mandatory conformity assessments. This marks the first significant enforcement action under the EU AI Act, which entered full enforcement mode in January 2026. Legal experts say the ruling signals a new era of strict AI accountability across Europe.

articles.title: Meta Releases LLaMA 4 Scout Open Weights Model with Native RAG Architecture
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced LLaMA 4 Scout, a 70-billion parameter model built with a native retrieval-augmented generation architecture that dramatically improves factual accuracy without fine-tuning. The model includes a built-in vector index mechanism that allows it to ground responses against external knowledge bases at inference time. Researchers are already reporting benchmark improvements of up to 22% on knowledge-intensive tasks compared to standard LLaMA 4 variants.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Real-Time Video Understanding for Meeting Analysis
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to Copilot Studio introducing real-time video understanding, enabling enterprise agents to analyze live video streams from Teams meetings and generate structured action items, sentiment analysis, and compliance flags. The feature uses a custom multimodal model co-developed with OpenAI optimized for low-latency inference. The update is available to all Microsoft 365 E5 subscribers starting this week.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Compounding Risks in Multi-Agent AI Systems
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released a 94-page report detailing emergent safety risks that arise when multiple autonomous AI agents interact within shared environments. The report documents 17 case studies where agent coordination failures led to unintended real-world consequences, including erroneous financial transactions and data exfiltration attempts. Researchers are calling for mandatory sandboxing standards and cross-agent audit trails before large-scale agentic deployments.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Edge 3B: A Compact Model Designed to Run on Smartphones
articles.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has announced Mistral Edge 3B, a 3-billion parameter model specifically optimized to run entirely on-device on modern Android and iOS smartphones without requiring a network connection. The model uses a novel 4-bit quantization scheme co-designed with Qualcomm and Apple Silicon teams to fit within 2GB of RAM while maintaining competitive performance on instruction-following tasks. Mistral says the model will be available for download via its La Plateforme API and directly integrated into select Samsung Galaxy and iPhone 17 devices later this quarter.
